title: Best Mobile Games Like Character AI 2026 – With Visuals And Real Roleplay
summary: Want games like Character AI that play like a real roleplay game? Compare 5 free-to-start picks for iOS and Android, from Redbean to Enjoy AI Town in 2026.
body_markdown:

Each has a free way to start roleplaying with your AI-driven characters.

##


Why players want roleplay games like Character AI


#


**Character.AI** gives millions of people a very personal way to[roleplay with AI characters](https://me.mashable.com/tech/28412/characterai-what-it-is-and-how-to-use-it) : characters that feel deep, responsive, and human. Recent filter/rules changes have left users frustrated, and Character.AI also[filed for bankruptcy](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/13/just-5-years-in-interactive-chatbot-platform-character-ai-files-for-bankruptcy/) on 12 October 2026 (though the app keeps running during the sale process). Many players now look for alternative options that they can keep on a phone, with better storytelling and real character interaction. That’s also where most chat apps like Character AI stop short: no interactive character, no visual world to explore, no consequences for what you say, and a text-only roleplay experience.


By contrast, **game-native apps with AI-driven characters** can fix that with a persistent world, character systems that mimic human-like reactions: your response tone can shift NPCs’ attitude, and conversations can lead to new plot development. Real *[AI roleplay games](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/ai-roleplay-games-with-characters)* like Character AI with this depth are still rare. The five listed below can help bridge that gap through similar character-driven appeal and visual worlds you can walk into.

##


**5 Roleplay Games Like Character AI With Visuals for iOS and Android**


#


###


**Redbean** : Roleplay in a visual world where you can talk to any NPC


#


*Platform: Android & iOS · Free to play, subscriptions from $9.99/month*


[Redbean](https://www.redbean.ai/) lets you fill a town with your own cast – **[playable characters](https://www.redbean.ai/characters)** created just from an image or sketch, and you can play as any of them in your own stories. It’s pitch against Character AI comes down to two things: a **visual world** instead of a chat window, and **full ownership of your cast** . You define each character’s persona, lore, role, and speaking style, shape their relationships, and roleplay with them in town settings.


*NPCs hold the context of your storyline, remember what you’ve told them, and respond **in-character***


Among roleplay apps like Character AI on mobile (see our[Redbean vs Character AI comparison](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/character-ai-alternative) for more detail), Redbean offers wide **creative freedom** in character creation, open-ended conversations with AI-driven NPCs, and world building. Your world can also hold your favorite characters, such as[crew from Project Hail Mary movie](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/project-hail-mary-game-roleplay) or the[horror characters from Animal Hospital](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-characters) .


**The main trade-off:** Character AI lets you roleplay *with* a character, while Redbean lets you roleplay *through* a world. You can still talk to any NPC, but your attention spreads across a cast and a town. Characters also start from a picture, photo, or sketch rather than a text prompt alone. In return, you are building an entire world of your own.

###


Enjoy AI Town: roleplay with the ready-made AI characters


#


*Platform: Android and iOS (rated 18+ on the App Store). Price: free to download; optional purchases include a $4.99 weekly plan and a $19.99 monthly plan*


[Enjoy AI Town](https://apps.apple.com/app/enjoy-ai-town/id6468901311) is a *social/world simulator* rather than an RPG, which set in a town of about 4,000 AI residents – the largest cast among these apps. For roleplaying setting, you chat with 2D character art, share gifts, take characters on adventures, and unlock story mode as a relationship grows. You can also build custom characters and change outfits, each has their own personality, memory, and can talk back using voice.


**Where it falls short:** Players report that romance features and pictures sit behind a paywall. The cast is large, but you have less control over the world than in a town you build yourself. For players who want games like Enjoy AI Town, Redbean is a closest match – it lets you build your own place where all of your characters live together.


###


**Talkie AI** : quick one-on-one character roleplay


#


*Platform: Android, iOS, browser · Free tier with 50 messages a day, paid subscription from $9.99/month*


[Talkie AI](https://www.talkie-ai.com/) (or *Talkie Lab* ) gives you a library of highly customized, AI-driven characters and lets you create your own. Chats are fast and close to the Character AI format, with a heavier emphasis on **AI art/cards** and **voice features** . Talkie is a good pick when conversation is all you want and you do not need a map, a town, or a plot that moves on its own.


Among chat apps like Character AI with visual layers (for PolyBuzz fans, see this[PolyBuzz alternative with a game world](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/polybuzz-alternative) ), **Talkie AI** comes closest as a chat platform with rich visual cards and a Mini-Theater feature: Each character has detailed and collectible AI-generated artworks (often in anime or digital art styles), a background for roleplay setting, and branching choices instead of a plain text thread.


**The main trade-off:** it relies on thousands of preset personas rather than a character you build yourself, there’s no interactive character roleplay beyond chat and no persistent map or town to return to. Talkie also utilizes[stricter, safety filters](https://aiinsightsnews.net/talkie-ai/) that keep roleplay within a PG-13 baseline. Players who want games like Talkie with a world behind the chat can try Redbean.


###


RPBuddy


#


*Platform: Browser only, no mobile app · Paid subscription plans from $10/month*


[RPBuddy](https://www.rpbuddy.ai/) is an AI RPG sandbox and a text-first roleplay tool for players who care more about writing than visuals. You can build a visual hex map world with buildings and meet NPCs living in a simulated setting, but most of scenes stay in text and your own writing carries the story. You can customize the visual aesthetic of characters and world using several AI-generated styles (retro, modern anime, cartoon).


Among games like Character AI, **RPBuddy** leans hardest into RPG systems: tactical turn-based combat against custom enemies and an economy system. Its chats play out like an interactive visual novel where NPCs can remember, gossip with each other and form opinions about you, the kind of multi-character awareness Character AI rarely offers.


**The honest gap:** RPBuddy is browser-based with no dedicated mobile app for Android and iOS, and it isn’t free to keep using past a 7-day trial.


###


**Friends & Fables** : turn-based adventures


#


*Platform: Browser, Discord (Android & iOS) · Free tier with maximum 25 AI turns a day; paid plans from $19.95/month*


[Friends & Fables](https://fables.gg/) is an AI roleplay game specifically built to simulate a **traditional tabletop RPG experience** , heavily inspired by **Dungeons & Dragons** . You play as an AI dungeon master named Franz who runs D&D 5e-style campaigns solo or with friends, tracking health, inventory, and skill checks as you type text-based actions. It suits players who want rules and a clear arc instead of open-ended chat.


This is one of the games like **Character AI** with the most robust creation tools: using AI image generation tools, you can create custom visuals like top-down regional and dungeon maps, write custom lore, homebrew items, and create monsters, then watch your character & enemies token move across the world map in real-time.


Among gaming-native Character AI roleplay apps, **Friends & Fables** leans hardest into structure: your words trigger real mechanical consequences instead of a dramatic response that resets next turn. **Where it falls short:** it’s not a native mobile app, and the D&D ruleset means you’re playing inside tabletop mechanics rather than a real RPG game world. The daily cap on the free tier ends sessions early at 25 turns, and paid plans cost more than the others on this list.


##


**F** requently Asked Questions


#


####


What makes a roleplay game with AI characters different from an AI chatbot or companion?


A chatbot or companion gives you one character in an open-ended chat. A roleplay game adds structure around the conversation: a place to live in, a cast that relates to each other, and systems such as town-building, quests, or turn-based combat. Redbean builds this around your own cast in a pixel town, and RPBuddy around a hex map. The trade-off is more to manage than a single chat.


####


Which apps like Character AI are free to start?


Redbean, Enjoy AI Town, Talkie, and RPBuddy all have a free start. Redbean gives 50 daily credits, with plans from $9.99 a month. Enjoy AI Town is free to download with optional purchases. RPBuddy’s free tier offers 50 AI actions a day in the browser. If you want games like Talkie without paying upfront, Enjoy AI Town and Redbean are the closest free starts. Every free tier caps daily use, so check the limits first.


####


Which roleplay game is most like Enjoy AI Town?


Among games like Enjoy AI Town, Redbean is the closest: both are town-based, and you build relationships with the characters who live there. The difference is the cast. Enjoy AI Town starts with about 4,000 ready-made residents, while in Redbean you create your own from a picture, photo, or sketch. Pick Enjoy AI Town for instant variety, and Redbean for a cast you own.


####


Any AI-driven roleplay games where I can create my own character?


Yes. Redbean lets you create a character from a picture, photo, or sketch, set its persona, backstory, and speaking style, and play as one of them. Enjoy AI Town also lets you create characters, locations, and pets. Of the games like Character AI covered here, these two give you the most control over your own cast.


####


What happens to Character.AI? Can I import my characters and chats into these apps?


Per[BetaNews](https://betanews.com/article/character-ai-bankruptcy-chapter-11/) , Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 on 12 October 2026, and the service stays online during the sale. We found no import tool for Character.AI characters or chats in the apps above. But you can recreate or rebuild a character by copying its persona, backstory, and speaking style (Redbean also needs a picture, photo, or sketch). If a Character AI roleplay app holds long threads you care about, copy them out while it is online.


##


How to pick a roleplay game like Character AI


#


- Want to play your own character in a visual world: Redbean.
- Want a huge cast from the first minute: Enjoy AI Town.
- Want one-on-one character chat with avatar: Talkie.
- Want a text-first story and deep writing: RPBuddy.
- Want a game-master-style campaign: Friends & Fables.


Among roleplay apps like Character AI, the trade-off is control against convenience. A ready-made cast is faster to start. A world you build yourself takes a few minutes of setup and pays off in scenes that feel like yours. For more recommendation, we’ve covered a wider look at the AI-driven RPG games in[AI roleplay games with characters](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/ai-roleplay-games-with-characters) .


##


Final thoughts


#


If chat alone has started to feel flat, try a Character AI roleplay app that gives you a real game world to play in. Redbean is a free place to start, with characters who live their own life in a world you build, on Android and iOS. For a side-by-side comparison, see our[Character AI alternative guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/character-ai-alternative) .
